_comment: Optional per-repo polish for the CAB | GAME | HARDWARE table.
Keyed by exact repo name. Every field is optional — anything you leave
out falls back to live GitHub data (description, topics, languages).
A brand-new repo needs NO entry here: it appears automatically with the
default icon and its own description. Add an entry only when you want
a custom icon, a richer blurb, or hand-picked hardware tags.
icon      emoji shown in the CAB column      (default: joystick)
blurb     replaces the repo description      (default: description)
hardware  list of tags for HARDWARE column   (default: topics, then languages)

NEONAMP.blurb: self-hosted Winamp-style web music player with a cyberpunk neon deck. Spectrum visualizer, 10-band EQ, OBS jukebox overlay, Twitch chat commands, EBU R128 loudness normalization

VoidCompass.blurb: native Windows companion for Elite Dangerous. Live journal tracking, exploration / trade / fleet / engineering tools, HUD overlays, adaptive cockpit AI
